name: KG Petrochem Limited
summary: Established on February 29, 1980, and headquartered in Jaipur, India, KG Petrochem Limited specializes in the production and sale of textiles and garments, alongside the distribution of polymers. The company's activities are organized into distinct segments: The Textile division manufactures and markets a range of products including terry towels, made-ups, and ready-to-wear apparel like bathrobes, babyhood towels, and pillows, catering to both domestic and international customers. Its Technical Textile segment is dedicated to crafting artificial leather utilizing technical textile processes. Additionally, the Agency segment manages the marketing and distribution of polymers specifically within the Rajasthan region.
